topics.description: The FBI is currently investigating multiple high-profile cases, including the investigation into former counterterrorism chief Joe Kent. This trend is significant as it highlights the agency's efforts to address potential security threats and leaks of classified information.

Tesla's self-driving feature, known as FSD, is under investigation by the NHTSA due to concerns over its safety. This trend is significant as it highlights the growing concerns over the development and deployment of self-driving technology.
